gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: My brother works ___ a hospital in Leeds.
gaps.explanation: 'in a hospital' = inside the building; 'at hospital' would mean as a patient (BrE).

gaps.sentence: The fire is believed ___ by faulty wiring.
gaps.explanation: 'believed to have been + participle' — the cause was earlier.
Present perfect continuous for duration up to now: has been watching.

gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
